name: moonshot-csgo
description: Moonshot Frisbee Games: multiplayer frisbee FPS on the FF-01 campus

scripts.build: vite build && wrangler pages functions build functions --project-directory . --build-output-directory dist --outdir dist --output-routes-path dist/_routes.json && mv dist/index.js dist/_worker.js
scripts.campus:build: vite build && node tools/precompressStatic.mjs && esbuild server/node/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node22 --packages=bundle --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);" --outfile=dist-server/campus-server.mjs
scripts.server:dev: wrangler dev --config server/wrangler.toml --port 8787 --var ALLOWED_ORIGINS:localhost,127.0.0.1 --var START_AMMO:9 --var COMBAT_TEST:1
scripts.test:e2e:prod: npm run build && playwright test --config playwright.production.config.ts
